mapper.select: SELECT A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , ROWNUM AS INDEX_SN , B.FRST_REG_DT , B.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD AS INSPTN_YMD , B.SRVC_PVSN_TTL_NM AS RESRCE FROM SEB510 A, SEB500 B, SDA100 C WHERE A.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND A.SRVC_PVSN_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO AND B.RESRCE_NO = C.RESRCE_NO AND C.SRVC_RESRCE_MLSFC_SE_CD = '0203' /* 건강검진 */
